newsitem.title: UK: Dow Jones to add UK staff after Primark deal.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones to add UK staff after Primark deal.

text.p: News and information vendor Dow Jones & Co Inc said on Thursday it would add editorial staff in London to support a new financial information joint venture for equity traders and investors with Primark Corp.
Primark, whose businesses include historical financial information service Datastream, earlier said it was acquiring UK equity data and news service ICV Ltd, in a related move.

Arjen Bongard, Dow Jones senior editor for Europe, Middle East and Africa, told Reuters the ICV news staff of around 20 would join Dow Jones' London newsroom and said, "we will be adding staff on top of that."

The joint venture will offer global financial data, but its initial focus is on the equities market in Britain and Ireland where ICV operates, Primark and Dow Jones said in a joint statement in the United States. They expected to launch the new service in the first half of 1997.

A spokesman for Reuters Holdings Plc, ICV's main rival in the British equities news and information market, said the company would not comment until it had fully studied the Dow Jones/Primark announcement. Reuters this year launched its 3000 series of products, which add historical financial data to its real-time news and price information systems.

Dow Jones' Bongard said of the link with ICV and Primark: "It will provide us with a major opportunity to make Dow Jones Europe news as prominent and indispensible in the UK and the rest of Europe as in the U.S."
He said Dow Jones in London now has 80 news staff, although this would rise to close to 100 early next year as editing staff move from New York in a previously-planned development.
ICV officials were initially unavailable for comment.
